about: Perspective ring templates of the sketcher's 2D depiction (serve/depiction_templates.py). ring_templates.smi holds the pictures: hand-made textbook perspective drawings (Clayden, Eliel), x right, y up, drawing units (a bond is about 1.5), generic * atoms and ~ bonds. Here, per template: `fit`, the parent's MMFF structure (20 srETKDGv3 embeddings, the seed given, MMFF94, lowest energy) turned to the orthographic view that best reproduces the picture with the `front` atoms (template indices) in front, same atom order and units, used to match a molecule's 3D structure and to derive the exocyclic slots; `depth`, its z (+ towards the viewer), which orders the crossings the sketcher breaks; `foreshortened`, bonds drawn short on purpose (receding); `crossings`, how many the picture has; `snap_deg`, how far a slot is snapped onto the vertical or a ring-bond direction (30 for the stylised chairs: axial vertical, equatorial parallel to the ring bonds once removed); `slot_overrides`, hand-set drawn slot directions. `ksmech-serve gallery --derive-templates` re-derives fit and depth from the pictures (derivation.projection_rms: how far, in bond lengths, the picture departs from a true projection).

cyclohexane-chair.title: cyclohexane chair
cyclohexane-chair.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C1CCCCC1
cyclohexane-chair.convention: textbook chair: three bond directions (55, -20, 10 deg) each drawn twice, all bonds one length; axial bonds vertical, equatorial bonds parallel to the ring bonds once removed; left tip low, right tip high, seen from above

norbornane.title: bicyclo[2.2.1]heptane (norbornane, camphor, borneol)
norbornane.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C1CC2CCC1C2
norbornane.convention: boat-like six-ring seen from the front and above: bridgeheads left and right, the two-atom front bridge at the bottom, the back bridge inside drawn short (receding), the C7 bridge above as a roof; syn/anti C7 substituents drawn as a V; no crossing

bicyclo222.title: bicyclo[2.2.2]octane (quinuclidine, DABCO)
bicyclo222.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C1CC2CCC1CC2
bicyclo222.convention: the barrel: bridgeheads left and right, the top and the front bridge as a hexagon, the back bridge inside drawn short (receding); no crossing

tropane.title: bicyclo[3.2.1]octane (tropane, cocaine)
tropane.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C1CC2CCC(C1)C2
tropane.convention: the N bridge over a chair: the one-atom bridge on top, the three-atom bridge in front as the lower half of a chair (C3 the bottom tip), the two-atom bridge behind, inside, drawn short; N substituents drawn as a V; no crossing

adamantane.title: adamantane
adamantane.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C1C2CC3CC1CC(C2)C3
adamantane.convention: the standard chair-based drawing: a textbook chair at the bottom, three parallel near-vertical bonds (80 deg) rising from its upper atoms, joined at the apex; one crossing at the centre

cubane.title: cubane
cubane.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C12C3C4C1C5C2C3C45
cubane.convention: an oblique (cabinet) cube: the front face a square, the receding edges drawn at 37 degrees and 0.73 long, two crossings (the rear edges broken)

trans-decalin.title: trans-decalin (two chairs)
trans-decalin.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF [C@@H]12CCCC[C@H]1CCCC2
trans-decalin.convention: two textbook chairs in the standard zig-zag: the second chair is the first turned 180 degrees about the shared bond (trans fusion), the fusion H axial

cis-decalin.title: cis-decalin (two chairs)
cis-decalin.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF [C@@H]12CCCC[C@@H]1CCCC2
cis-decalin.convention: a textbook chair with the second chair rising from its right end through an axial bond (the L-shaped cis-decalin), bonds one length

steroid.title: steroid core, all chairs, trans-anti-trans (5alpha)
steroid.source: hand-made picture (serve/data/ring_templates.smi); fit and depth derived from MMFF C[C@@]12CCC[C@H]1[C@@H]1CC[C@H]3CCCC[C@]3(C)[C@H]1CC2
steroid.convention: rings A to D left to right: A, B and C textbook chairs fused trans (each turned 180 degrees about the shared bond), C3 at the left tip, the angular methyls on the vertical axial slots at C10 and C13, D a regular pentagon on C13-C14
